description: This Java source file defines an aspect for logging and monitoring SQL database calls within the Thingsboard server, including statistics collection, deadlock detection, and tenant-specific call tracking.

classes.name: SqlDaoCallsAspect
classes.description: Aspect class for intercepting SQL DAO calls, collecting statistics, and logging tenant-specific database call metrics.

methods.name: printStats
methods.description: Scheduled method to log collected database call statistics at regular intervals.

methods.name: logSnapshot
methods.description: Logs a snapshot of database call statistics with optional limits and sorting.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a list of current database call statistics snapshots.

methods.name: logTopNTenants
methods.description: Logs top tenants based on specified comparator and limit.

methods.name: handleSqlCall
methods.description: Around advice that intercepts methods annotated with @SqlDao, tracks execution, and handles success/failure reporting.

methods.name: reportFailedMethodExecution
methods.description: Handles logging and statistics update when a SQL method fails, including deadlock detection.

methods.name: reportSuccessfulMethodExecution
methods.description: Updates statistics for successful method execution.

methods.name: reportMethodExecution
methods.description: Updates call count and timing for a specific tenant and method.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Extracts TenantId from method arguments or logs invalid method calls.

methods.name: addAndLogInvalidMethods
methods.description: Records method names that do not correctly pass tenant identifiers.
